description:
Residential reconfiguration and refurbishment of the existing mixed-use property at Chapel Market, including the reconfiguration of the existing 3-bedroom dwelling to provide 1 x 2-bedroom, 3-person flat and 1 x 2-bedroom, 3-person triplex flat (Use Class C3 to C3) on the upper floors. The change of use class is only in the rear portion of the ground floor, with part of the existing retail unit
restructured to introduce an independent residential entrance, a reconfigured internal staircase, and residential cycle and refuse storage
spaces (Use Class E to Use Class C3), whilst retaining a 66.4 sqm commercial unit at the front. The scheme also proposes the erection of a firstfloor rear infill extension and the formation of a new attic level within the existing roof profile to optimize underutilized volume without increasing the overall height of the building. External works comprise the replacement of the existing residential entrance on Chapel Market with a new commercial entrance door to match neighboring properties, the installation of two rooflights within the first-floor roof slope, and the formation of two new east-facing windows at first-floor level for adequate daylight and ventilation.
Written advice (only)	£942.97 	£188.59	£1,131.56
